two_fluid_fractions.interpretation: Superfluidity does not require a 100% single-particle condensate. Strong repulsive hard-core interactions deplete the ground-state BEC fraction to ~7.5% at low T, while macroscopic superfluid density fraction rho_s/rho approaches 100%.

quantum_zero_point_solidification.mechanism: Helium-4 remains liquid down to absolute zero at ambient pressure because large quantum zero-point kinetic energy prevents lattice crystallization unless compressed to >= 25.3 bar.
